01 / About

A little bit design, a little bit dev.

I'm a B.Tech Computer Science student at Trinity Institute of Innovations in Professional Studies, with a growing focus on graphic design, branding, and digital experiences.

As a Design Member at Code Rangers, I create posters, banners, and social media assets for student events — and work closely with a team to keep every design consistent across platforms.

This summer, I'm interning across three teams simultaneously: Web Development at Prodigy InfoTech, Graphics Design at CodeAlpha, and as a Graphic Designer Intern at AHEAD — putting both sides of my toolkit to work at once.

Outside of design tools, I'm comfortable in Python, Java, and C/C++, and I'm actively exploring how AI-assisted ("vibe") coding can speed up how quickly an idea goes from sketch to screen.
